tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (nga )༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje tshe'i bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /'bum phrag zla ba'i dkyil 'khor
(nga )༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje tshe'i bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /'bum phrag zla ba'i dkyil 'khor

tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje tshe'i bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs// 'bum phrag zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las bton ltar// dkar 'tsher sku yi phyag g.yon mchog sbyin las// bskal pa'i ring 'tsho'i dngos grub dga' ston mkhan// bla ma rdo rje tshe mchog gtsug tu mchod// de tshul phyag na rdo rje'i zhal gyi lung*// rgyud dang mkhas pa'i gzhung gi dag byed rgyun// gcig tu rab 'khyil legs bshad padma'i rdzing*// don gnyer lha bu rtse dgas rol phyir bskrun// 'dir phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ rdo rje tshe'i bsnyen sgrub bya ba'i tshul la bzhi/ bris sku 'dri ba dang*/ rab tu gnas pa dang*/ bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga dang*/ de'i phan yon bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ lha bzo ba gso sbyong dang ldan pas/ ras 'dul byas pa la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje tshe 'og gi rab gnas skabs kyi bskyed chog dang mthun par bris nas gong gsham 'dogs pa bcas grub par bya'o// gnyis pa rab tu gnas pa ni/ de ltar bris zin pa de la rgyud 'di nyid nas bstan pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga bya ba la/ kun rig la brten pa'i rab gnas sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i dngos grub 'byung ba'am/ dpal 'byor rgya mtsho gzhir bzhag nas de'i khyad par rnams 'jam pa'i dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas zur du bkol ba don bco lngas bstan pa ltar byas na/ kun gyis go bar sla bas de nyid gzhir bzhag ste/ khyad par ni/ dang po legs par bshams pa ni/ rten de'i mdun du mnga' dbul gyi yo byad dang chos skyong bsgo ba'i gtor ma ma gtogs pa'i nyer spyod dang rab gnas la mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad dang slob dpon gyi mdun du bum pa gsum sogs tshang bar bsham mo// gnyis pa bdag bskyed pa ni/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa dang skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/

bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i mjug gi mchod bstod kyi bar 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs dkyus ltar bya'o// gsum pa bum pa bzla ba ni/ rnam rgyal la lha bcu gsum dang*/ las bum la rdo rje gnod sbyin kun rig skabs nas 'byung bas gsal gdab cing bskyed de/ rdo rje gnod sbyin la/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ zhes pa brgya rtsa dang*/ khrus kyi don du/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pa nyer gcig bzla ba ma gtogs gzhan thams cad dkyil 'khor cho ga'i skabs dang 'dra'o// de nas khrus bum gyi steng gzungs thag rdo rje bzhag ste/ las bum gyi chus gtor te/ bsang sbyangs nas/ rten gyi dri ma sbyong ba'i nus ldan gyur zhes pa'i bar bya'o// bzhi pa rten sbyang ba/ lnga pa khrus bya ba/ drug pa ring bsrel gzhug pa/ bdun pa gsol ba gdab pa rnams kun rig gi rab gnas ltar bya'o// brgyad pa rten bskyed pa ni/ yakṣas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ ras bris mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje tshe zla ba'i 'od can/ padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa las 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pa/ de'i 'og tu sgrub pa po lag pa brkyang ste thal mo sbyar nas gdong gyen du phyogs nas bcom ldan 'das la blta ba'i kha dang spyi bor bdud rtsi bab pa'i rnam pa can gyi skur gyur par bsam/ dgu pa ye shes pa spyan drangs shing dgug gzhug bya ba/ bcu gcig pa rgyas gdab pa gnyis rgyas pa'i sta gon dang 'dra ba las/ dgug gzhug pa/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha sogs khyad par ro// bcu gcig pa dbang bskur ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ/

zhes pas spyan drangs/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa bteg nas/ nam mkha'i lha tshogs slob dpon dang bcas pas rten gyi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bzhag ste dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra ka la sha sogs nas aḥ/ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang bum chu ting phor la sogs par blugs la/ mchod g.yog pas rten gyi mdun du bzhag de nas dbu rgyan thogs la/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa sogs nas aḥ/ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur ba'i tshul byas la mdun du 'bul/ yang rtsa chings/ oṃ ratna sogs nas trām̐ zhes dang*/ dar dpyangs/ oṃ badzra pa tā lamba nas trām̐ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur la 'bul/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'bul bar bsam zhing*/ dngos su rdo rje dang dril bu lhan cig gtod de/ oṃ badzra mu dra sogs brjod cing dbang bskur la 'bul/ slob dpon rang gi mdun gyi rdo rje dril bu lhan cig dkrol zhing*/ oṃ badzra nā ma sogs brjod cing rigs lnga'i gsang mtshan gdags pas dbang bskur/ de dag brtan pa'i phyir sna tshogs rdo rje 'bul bar bsams la/ oṃ badzra karma sogs brjod pa rdo rje brtul zhugs te 'di la dbang rdzas dngos su mi mdzad do// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i phyag rgya rten la gtugs pas/ seng ge'i khri sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rdo rje sems dpar gyur par bsams kyin/ oṃ badzra tsakra nas bhrūm̐ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur/ de la dam tshig gsum gyi phyir/ rang gi mdun gyi rdo rje dril bu lhan cig rten gyi gnas lngar dkrol te/ oṃ badzra tsakra sogs brjod/ slob dpon nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor rten dang bcas pas phyag rgya mdzad par bsams kyin/ oṃ badzra tsakra sogs sngar bzhin brjod/

yum lnga'i phyag mtshan rten gyi gnas lngar bzhag mthar phyag g.yon du phul bar bsam zhing*/ dngos su dril bu rkyang pa dkrol la/ oṃ badzra dhā ra ṇa sogs brjod/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gnas lngar gtugs te mthar phyag g.yas su phul bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje gsor zhing dngos su dbul ba'i tshul bya/ oṃ badzra gu hya sogs brjod de rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// de ltar dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rten gyi spyi bor mi bskyod pa/ dpral ba rnam par snang mdzad/ rna ltag g.yas par rin 'byung*/ ltag par 'od dpag med/ rna ltag g.yon par don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// bcu gnyis pa mchod bstod bya ba ni/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'jig rten khams ni sogs kyis mchod yon sngon 'gro'i me tog nas rol mo'i bar dang*/ bstod pa mtshan bcu'am/ snang stong rdo rje sogs kyis spyi bstod bya'o// bcu gsum pa spyan dbye ba dang*/ bcu bzhi pa zhal bsgyur zhing brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba ni spyi 'gro ltar bya'o// bco lnga pa mchod bstod rgyas pa'i mnga' dbul ni/ mchod pa kha gsos te byin gyis brlabs/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho nas sparṣe kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐ gi bar mdun bskyed kyi skabs ltar dang*/ bstod pa mtshan brgya'am mtshan bcu gang rung gis bstod de/ de nas rgyud 'di nas bshad pa'i bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs pa sogs/ dmigs pa bya ba ni me tog thogs la ngag tu/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i byin gyis rlabs kyis 'jig rten gyi khams ma zhig gi bar du bdag cag gi rten 'di la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad rab tu gnas par gyur cig dngos grub thams cad stsol cig bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod cing me tog 'thor/ yang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/

gsang sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ bdag la dngos grub tu 'gyur na sku gzugs kyi rten 'di las rtags sna tshogs pa mthong bar gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod cing me tog 'thor ro// de nas sku gzugs de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sngags bkod pa la dmigs te/ rten la gzungs thag btags pa bzung nas/ oṃ puṇye puṇye sogs dang*/ oṃ bhrūm̐ badzra ā yu ṣe dang*/ las kyi sngags oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ zhes pa ci nus dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzrā ya swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbhu khaṃ badzrī bha ba dṛ ḍha tiṣṭha bhu khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'ang ci nus bzla bar bshad do// de nas ston mchog dam pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis rgyas par byas la/ mthar mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya ba rnams ni rab gnas kyi cho ga'o// tshul 'di la rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha dang*/ ras bris kyi rten bskyed dang*/ sgos bstod dang*/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa dang buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa go brje bas kun rig bsnyen sgrub skabs kyi rab gnas kyi sgos chos rnams kyang 'di kho nas rtogs par 'gyur ro// gsum pa bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga la gsum/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor ro// dang po ni/ de ltar rab gnas legs par byas pa'i ras bris de nyid kyang logs su bkram pa'i mdun du ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang*/ cha gsum gyi gtor ma rnams bsham/ rang nyid rten de la zhal phyogs par gnas pa'i rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bsham/ sngon 'gror cha gsum gtor ma btang ste mtshams bcad la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i gong gi mchod bstod kyi bar gzhung bzhin nyams su blangs/ de nas

bsnyen pa'i tshe rgyud 'grel sogs nas sngar rab gnas kyi dus su lha bskyed pa de dran pa tsam las/ 'dir lha bskyed pa ma bshad kyang*/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ ras gang zag gi blo la ma bde bar gyur na/ ras bris bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhūm̐ las 'og nas 'byung ba ltar lha bskyed brjod kyang mi 'gal te rab 'byams tshul 'od pas sbyong rgyud ras bris kyi bsnyen pa'i skabs nas de ltar du bya ba bshad pa'i phyir ro// bris kyi sku de nyid phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa de nyid la slar yang gsal gdab pa dran pa'i tshul gyis oṃ bhṛ ta sogs rigs gsum spyi'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa sogs kyis rigs lnga'i dbang bskur ba tsam bya'o// de nas bdag gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mtha' skor du sngags phreng bkod pa las sngags phreng 'od zer dang bcas pa 'phros/ mdun gyi ras bris rdo rje tsher gsal ba'i thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de'i phyag las 'bab pa'i bdud rtsi bdag gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas/ lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang*/ tshe dang bsod nams dang ye shes thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlabs par bsam zhing*/ puṇye'i sngags ci 'grub bzlas/ thun gyi mthar cha gsum btang ba dang bdag bskyed kyi rjes kyi bya ba/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ oṃ bhṛ ta sogs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa/ oṃ badzra satwa kro dha sogs kyis bsrungs nas/ dge ba bsngo ba rnams bya'o// de lta bus thun gsum mam bzhi la sogs pa'i sgo nas bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gsum mam drug bzla ba ni ras bris la brten pa'i bsnyen pa'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa la gnyis/ nyer sgrub dang*/ sgrub pa'o// dang po la'ang gnyis/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po ni zla ba gang yang rung ba'i gza' skar dang sbyor byed dge ba'i tshes gcig gam brgyad dam bcu gsum nas 'go brtsams/

sa gzhi ba byung lnga dang dri bzang pos byugs nas/ der skya thig rdzogs par btab/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang mthun par thig tshon byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ ye shes kyi thig 'debs rnams byas nas/ der rdul tshon gyis lha bcu gsum gyi mtshan ma can gyi dkyil 'khor du bri'o// de nas gser dngul la sogs pa'i snod gas chag med pa gtsang ma'i nang du ba dmar ser gyi mar gsar pa/ de ma 'byor na 'bri mar bzhus pa la/ bu ram la sogs pa'i mngar gsum bsres pa blugs nas/ de dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su man 'ji'am khri'u'i steng du bzhag de'i steng du gzungs thag rdo rje bzhag pa steng gi bris sku'i phyag gi bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i thad du 'ong bar bya/ de'i steng nas 'dogs thag la btags pa'i sngar gyi bris sku de la reg par zhal shar du phyogs par bsham/ de'i mdun nam g.yon phyogs gang bder sgrub pa po gdan 'ong bar byas/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar mchod gtor rgya chen po dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ bdag 'jug len na bum pa nang rdzas rgyan dang ldan par bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ khro bo ti rinti'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐ gis dkyil 'khor gyi khang par zhugs nas/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed sngon du btang ba'i mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod bstod pa yan chad grub par bya'o// bdag 'jug dbang bcas grub na legs mod ma grub kyang chad skyon med do// de nas mdun gyi bris sku tshe rdzas dang bcas bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i tshe rdzas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ de'i steng du bhrūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje tshe sogs nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pa'i rnam pa can du gyur ces pa'i bar gong ltar brjod/

de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bcom ldan 'das rdo rje tshe'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ/ zhes pa la sogs pa sgo ba bzhi'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dgug gzhug bcing dang dbyer med du byas/ oṃ bhṛ ta la sogs pa rigs gsum gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa la sogs pa rigs lnga'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ de bzhin du sbyar ba'i shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje mtshan brgya'am mtshan bcu gang yang rung bas bstod do// de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ sngar gyi gzungs thag nas lag pa g.yon pas bzung la/ thugs rgyud bskul ba'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin yang yang gsal btab cing khyad par phyag gi bdud rtsi bab pa 'og gi bdud rtsi la'ang thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams pa'i ngang nas/ oṃ bhrūm̐ badzra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas so// thun bsdu ba na/ mchod bstod sngar bzhin byas la/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang ba dang*/ gang yang bdag blo la sogs pas nongs pa bzod par gsol/ me tog thogs te phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' zhes sogs kyis bris sku la brtan bzhugs byas nas cha gsum gtor ma btang ngo*// rang nyid la oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsas dbang bskur ba la sogs pas bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba dang*/ mchod pa kha gsos te mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog bkra shis kyi bar bya'o// de lta bu'i rim pas sngags 'bum phrag gcig gam gsum la sogs pa bzla'o// gsum pa sgrub pa chen po'am las sbyor ni/ tshes bco lnga'i dgongs mo nyi ma rgas nas brtsams te/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐ gis dkyil 'khor gyi khang par zhugs pa nas bdag mdun sgrub mchod sngar bzhin dang*/

mdun gyi bris sku tshe rdzas dang bcas bskyed pa nas mchod bstod yan chad snga ma ji lta ba bzhin bya ste/ de'ang grub na nyer spyod kyi rjes su mchod pa nyer lnga/ sgeg sogs brgyad/ 'dod yon lnga rnams rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na de dag gi sngags mchod tsam byas na legs te rgyud 'di pa'i lugs kyi mchod pa khyad par ba yin pa'i phyir ro// de nas gzungs thag nas lag pa g.yon pas bzung ste skya rengs ma shar gyi bar mtshan thog thag tu sngar gyi sngags de nyid bzlas shing phyag gi bdud rtsi sngar gyi tshe rdzas kyi bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin bya'o// de ltar byas pas grub pa'i rtags ni lha'i sku bzhad pa dang*/ 'brug gi sgra dang rnga dang rol mo'i rang sgra sgrogs pa la sogs pa dang*/ sngar gyi rdzas la sngar ma byung ba'i dri'i ngad bzang po ldang ba'am/ drod dam rlangs pa'am du ba'am me byung ba'am/ 'od zer ram skar ma'i rnam pa 'phro ba la sogs pa'i mtshan ma rnams 'byung bar bshad do// bzhi pa las la sbyar ba ni/ de lta bu'i mtshan ma rnams byung ba'am/ ma byung na yang skya rengs shar ba'i cha la rdzas de mar gsar ram/ til mar ram/ chu'am 'o ma'am klad pa la sogs pa gang rung dang sbyar te/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas bdud rtsi dang bdag bsrung ba byas te/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar rab tu dwang ba'i yid rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag pas/ dngos sam nyams kyi snang bar/ rgyal ba dang rgyal ba'i sras sam/ 'jig rten la sogs pa'i rnam par mthong ba'am/ ma mthong na'ang de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa byas la lag pa thal mo sbyar te/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag gi tshe dang las dang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de dag gis kyang rdzas de dngos grub tu stsal te/ 'di la longs su spyad pas ji ltar 'dod pa de ltar du 'gyur bar gdon mi za'o// zhes gsung zhing gnang bas dngos grub thob sems kyi dmigs pas lag gnyis kyis gus pa'i tshul gyis blangs nas rang nyid rdo rje tshe'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas tshim par longs spyad par gal che ste/ gsang sngags pa thar pa'am 'bras bu lam du byed pas dngos grub thams cad 'grub par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de nas oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa la sogs pas bdag bskyed kyi mjug gi bya ba dang mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog nongs pa bzod par gsol gyi bar byas nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad ces sogs kyis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod cing lha'i mtshan ma nas blangs pa rang gzhan gyi mgo bor bzhag la 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam/ rdul tshon mtha' nas phyags te/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor dor zhing*/ 'o ma'am dri bzang gi chus thig rjes bsubs la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas te/ ston mchog dam pa la sogs pa'i bkra shis rgyas par bya'o// bzhi pa de'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas ji skad bstan pa'i mtshan ma rnams byung ngam ma byung na'ang de'i yon tan ni/ rgyud las/ ji skad du/ mtshan ma ji lta ba bzhin byung na ni/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam par 'gyur zhing rdo rje sems dpa' dang mtshungs par 'gyur ro// tha ma'i tha mas kyang dngos grub thob pa la the tshom med do// mtshan ma ma byung na 'jig rten na nad med cing yid gzhungs pa dang lus la skra dkar dang gnyer ma med pa dang lus sra zhing tshe lo brgya par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang bzlas pa byas pa tsam gyis kyang zhi ba dang rgyas pa dang dbang la sogs pa'i las rnams brtag mi dgos par 'grub par 'gyur te the tshom med do// zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don la bsams pas shin tu yid ches pa'i gnas su 'gyur ba nyid do// 'dir smras pa/

byang chub sgrub pa'i srog la rngam pa'i kha// ches cher glal ba nyi ma'i bu yi dpung*// 'joms byed nges pa'i bdud rtsi 'di ko zhes// rgyud lung bye bas lan brgyar 'bod pa bzhin// rgyud dang mkhas pa'i legs bshad khengs ldan gzhur// man ngag nyag phran sbyar ba'i 'phong skyen gyis// bar chad bgegs kyi mi zin yongs bsgral nas// 'chi med grub pa'i sī ta rang dbang thob// 'di sbyar dge bas 'gro ba byang chub lam// sgrub pa'i tshe dang lang tsho bsod nams stobs// gaṅgā'i rgyun dang legs bris bu yi gzugs// chu gter 'khor los sgyur dbang rjes 'gror shog /ces bcom ldan 'das rdo rje tshe'i bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga 'chi med grub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'di'i bsnyen sgrub la zhugs pa dbu mdzad bla ma sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ mnga' ris rab 'byams pa tshul khrims 'od zer gyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi cho ga la gzhir byas/ der mi gsal ba rnams ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud 'grel rnams dang*/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po yab sras kyi legs bshad dri ma med pa rnams dang*/ tshul 'dir bka' drin zla med grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha' dpal bzang pa'i gsung sgros kyis kyang legs par brgyan te/ nyams su blang bde bar bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung 'dod pa'i 'bru mang zhes pa'i gnam lo'i rgyu skar lha mo chu stod kyis nya ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa phun sum tshogs pa'i sbyor ba 'dzom pa'i nyin lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par sbyar bar ā yuḥpuṇyo bardhantu// // ༄༅// phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i sbyin sreg 'bul ba'i tho yig bkra shis 'od 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// ye shes me yis bar chad tshang tshing bsregs// tshe dpal bsod nams rgyas pa'i mchog sbyin mkhan// bla ma ye shes me lhar gus btud de// rdo rje tshe yi sreg blugs cho ga 'dri// de la bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pa sngags kyi nus pa 'byin pa dang tshe'i bar chad zhi ba la sogs pa'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/

sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa'i kun rig rnam par snang mdzad 'khor dang bcas pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i yi ge gzhir bzhag nas/ 'dir mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams 'dri ba la/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ sa chog gi cha gsum gtang ba'i skabs kyi phrin las 'chol ba'i rjes su/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te zhes pa tsam bsgyur ba ma gtogs 'dra'o// thab kyi thig 'debs pa'i skabs su/ thig chen brgyad spyi ltar btab/ dbus nas sor brgyad bskor ba 'khor lo'i lte ba dkar po/ dbus su zla gdan gyi steng du gtso bo/ phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi'i mtshan ma bri/ de nas sor bzhi pa gsum bskor ba'i dang po la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad byas te/ mtshams bzhir bdug spos ma sogs bzhi/ phyogs bzhir sgo ba bzhi ste brgyad kyi mtshan ma rnams bri/ gnyis pa gzhi ser po la rdo rje dkar po'i phreng ba/ gsum pa gzhi dkar po la rdo rje rgya gram ljang gu/ de nas sor gnyis pa gnyis bskor ba'i dang po gzhi ljang gu la rin po che ser po/ gnyis pa gzhi ser po la padma dmar po/ de'i phyi rol du thab stegs gru bzhi la grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rtse nang du bstan pa bri/ de nas rdo rje'i phreng ba'i zlum skor gyi steng du srog chags med pa'i bud shing brtsigs pa nas yo byad thams cad la dri bzang gi chus gtor te gzhag go zhes pa'i bar gyi rdzas dang mchod pa bsham tshul sogs thams cad 'dra'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ snga dro'i dus su rang nyid khrus byas/ gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la/ rang gzhan gyi tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i sdig sgrib sbyang zhing tshe'i bar chad zhi ba dang sngags kyi nus pa dbyung bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas/ thab la zhal phyogs par skyil krung gis 'khod de/

bdag bskyed 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i bsgom bzlas mjug gi mchod bstod yan chad rdzogs par byas la/ dpal 'bar me sbar ba thogs te/ thab la g.yas phyogs su lan gsum bskor zhing*/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ zhes brjod de/ me sbar ba nas brtsams te/ thab bskyed cing me lha dang khro bo 'jig rten gsum rgyal dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshogs dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa' rnams spyan drangs nas mchod de/ bsreg rdzas 'bul ba rnams 'dra ba las/ 'on kyang spel tshig gi skabs bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las sgrib ci bsags pa dang bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi tshe/ gsang sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lhag po 'jug gsol gdab kyi tshe bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las sgrib ci bsags pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa tsam dang*/ bsnyen pa'i kha skong gi tshe/ gsang sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'jug sdig sgrib dgug pa'i tshe/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i las sgrib ci bsags pa dang bar du gcod pa thams cad bkug ste/ me la thim pas sdig sgrib dang nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad ye shes kyi mes bsreg par gyur ces brjod pa ma gtogs 'dra'o// de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i lto bar dbus dang phyogs bzhi dang*/ phyi'i phyogs mtshams brgyad rnams su padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re bsams la/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can sogs nas padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ gyi bar dkyil chog bzhin byas rdo rje sems dpa'i lto bar so so'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/

dbus su bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa sogs nas/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar gyis bum bskyed kyi skabs ltar gsal gdab/ oṃ bhṛ ta sogs kyis gnas gsum byin brlabs dang*/ oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes sogs rigs lngas dbang bskur te/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin rlabs pa nas brtsams te/ phyag 'tshal rdo rje 'bebs pa la'o// zhes bstod pa'i bar 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi mdun bskyed skabs bzhin bya/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ gtso bo la oṃ puṇye sogs sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i yam shing phul ba'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pas bdag dang sems can sogs spel tshig gong ltar brjod/ mar dang bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams la'ang des 'gre'o// de nas oṃ kaṃ ka ni'i sngags nyer gcig dang grangs mnyam pa'i yam shing phul mthar/ bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pas bdag dang sems can sogs spel tshig brjod/ mar dang bsreg rdzas rnams la'ang des 'gre/ de bzhin du oṃ ratne sogs nyer gcig dang bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan gyis/ oṃ a mi te sogs nyer gcig dang bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyis/ oṃ a mo gha sogs nyer gcig dang bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pas sogs bsreg rdzas gsum ga la rigs 'gres 'bul/ lha mo bzhi la/ oṃ badzra dhū pe sogs nas gandhe āḥ'i bar gyi sngags rnams lan bdun bdun bsdoms te brjod pa'i grangs mnyam gyi yam shing phul mthar/ rdo rje bdug spos ma/ me tog ma/ mar me ma/ dri chab ma ste lha mo bzhis kyang bdag dang sems can sogs spel tshig bcas brjod/ de bzhin du mar dang bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams kyang bdun bdun sogs grangs ci rigs par 'bul/ oṃ badzra aṃ ku sha nas badzra ā we sha ya aḥ zhes pa'i bar gyis yam shing bdun bdun gyi mthar/

rdo rje lcags kyu/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rdo rje lcags sgrog rdo rje 'bebs pa ste sgo ba bzhis kyang bdag dang sems can sogs spel tshig brjod/ de bzhin du bsreg rdzas gzhan gnyis kyang de ltar du 'bul lo// de ltar rdzas rnams rdzogs pa'i mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe thung bar gyur pa'i las sgrib ci bsags pa thams cad byang zhing dag pa dang*/ gsang sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ de nas kha skong gi sngags bsag dgos pa'i tshe/ til la rang gzhan gyi sdig sgrib dang bar chad la sogs pa bstim pa'i dmigs pa spyi ltar byas nas/ slar yang de nyid ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa lha thams cad kyi zhal du phul bar bsams la/ oṃ puṇye puṇye sogs gtso bo'i sngags brgya rtsa re dang til brgya re/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis sogs spel tshig brjod pa bcas ci nus bsags te/ mthar mchod pa kha gsos te byin gyis brlabs nas mchod bstod gsol gdab rnams mdun bskyed rjes chog gi skabs ltar bya/ slar yang bsreg rdzas rnams 'jig rten gsum rgyal phyogs skyong 'byung po bgegs rigs rnams dang*/ sgos kyi chos skyong nag po chen po rnams la phul nas bar chad zhi bar gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ rigs drug gi sems can la sbyin pa dang*/ rdzas kyi lhag mas slar yang me lha la grangs ci rigs par phul nas mchod bstod byas pa'i bar thams cad 'dra'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa kha gsos nas gtor ma bran te/ cha gsum gzhi bdag gi gtor ma phrin las bcol ba rnams kun rig gi sbyin sreg gi skabs ji lta ba bzhin bya/ rang nyid la oṃ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ sogs kyis dbang bskur ba nas/

'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i mgron gshegs su gsol nas/ bkra shis rgyas par bya ba'i bar thams cad kun rig sbyin sreg dang 'dra bar byas pas legs par grub bo// smras pa/ las kyi dngos grub khengs ldan gangs ri'i bdag /sreg blugs cho ga'i yid 'phrog zur mig gis// bsnun pas dka' thub brtan pa rab phrogs nas// rnal 'byor u mar 'dod pa'i rtse dgar rol// de tshul nyung ngur legs sbyar dge ba yis// 'gro kun 'chi bdag bdud las rnam rgyal ba'i// mtho ris yon tan bdun la dbang 'byor zhing*// rnam 'dren chos la bya ba byed par shog /ces phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i sbyin sreg 'bul ba'i tho yig bkra shis 'od 'bar zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'di'i bsnyen sgrub la zhugs pa'i dbu mdzad bla ma sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa bi dza yantu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
